sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Virtual IBAN Issuance and Digital Wallet Reserve Management

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Mixed legal system: English common law, French civil law, and customary law; unitary national law for company and financial services matters
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Vanuatu–Australia Trade and Development Agreement (not yet in force? Need active maybe not)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus
Vanuatu–China Investment Protection Agreement? Need no.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 1 of 1996 (Cap. 222), ss. 8, 13, 23, 25 and 34; Financial Dealers Act No. 20 of 2011, ss. 6, 11 and 13; Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 40 of 2006, Part 3
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies and International Companies Registry Division, Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 6 - Application for Registration as an International Company, accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association and Declaration of Compliance, leading to issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act Cap. 222
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to the International Company itself under Cap. 222; subscribers may fix initial issued capital. However, for the Electronic Money Institution licence, VFSC will require certified evidence of paid-up share capital of at least USD 50,000 or its equivariant in Vatu, maintained at a licensed commercial bank in Vanuatu. No escrow account is imposed for the basic incorporation, but the EMI licence may require a prudential reserve or surety bond held with the regulator.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) The subscription list is approved and 100 ordinary shares of USD 1.00 each are allotted to the founding subscriber at par, payment in full having been received; (2) the registered office of the Company is fixed at [Address], Port Vila, Vanuatu, and the VFSC-registered agent is authorised to file all statutory notices and maintenance documents; (3) [Name] is appointed first Director and [Name] is appointed Company Secretary, each to act until replaced by ordinary resolution; (4) the Directors are authorised to open bank accounts, execute banking mandates, adopt the corporate seal, and make every filing required by the Financial Dealers Act and the AML/CFT regulatory framework.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Availability Search and Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - Name Reservation Window / Official Online Pre-clearance Desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a proposed corporate name in English using prescribed form. The name must end with 'Limited' and cannot contain words implying banking, trust, insurance or exchange activity without prior regulatory consent. Upon clearance, VFSC reserves the name for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Signed name reservation application
Certified copy of passport of the founding shareholder
One-paragraph statement of intended principal business
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as undesirable or confusingly similar, submit an alternative name through the same window within 14 days. A formal appeal may be addressed to the VFSC Registration Committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of International Company Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC-approved Registered Agent acting for the prospective International Company
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to draft the Memorandum of Association, Articles of Association, subscriber particulars, share allotment schedule, and registered agent/registered office engagement letters. The agent must verify all beneficial owners and obtain fit-and-proper information.
required_dossiers: VFSC name reservation certificate
Passport and proof of residential address for each shareholder, director and secretary
Bank or professional reference letter for each beneficial owner
Declaration of non-resident ownership, where applicable
Signed registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the draft constitutional documents, the registered agent must revise the object and capacity clauses or authorised capital provisions and re-submit within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry - Client Services Counter or Statutory Online Filing Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 6 together with the executed constitutional documents, notices of registered office and registered agent, consents to act, and proof of payment of the registration fee. VFSC performs completeness checks and may request clarifications before processing.
required_dossiers: Completed and signed Form 6 - Application for Registration
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent to act as Director and Company Secretary
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Receipted payment of VFSC filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If an application is queried, the applicant through its registered agent must respond to VFSC's deficiency letter within 14 days, correcting clerical, capital or object clause issues; failure to respond may cause the application to lapse.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC seals the registration file and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with a unique international company number. The certificate records the date of incorporation, name, and registered office. The company becomes a legal entity from the certificate date.
required_dossiers: Approved application file
VFSC filing fee receipt
Passport copy of the first director for company record
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains a typographical error or is lost, submit a notarised affidavit and replacement fee to VFSC; a corrected certificate will be issued within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting, Share Certificates and Corporate Governance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered Office in Port Vila, Vanuatu, or duly convened virtual board meeting permitted by the Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting to adopt the pro-forma board resolution, approve share allotment, designate the registered office, appoint directors/secretary, authorise execution of banking documents, and open the statutory corporate register. Minutes and resolutions must be entered in the company's minute book.
required_dossiers: Notice convening the first board meeting
Draft first board resolution in approved form
Proof of registered office address
Consent forms of appointed directors and secretary
Completed bank account application package
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC or professional advisers later reject any governance document, the board may ratify a corrective written resolution under the Articles, and the minute book should be retrospectively corrected under directors' certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Money Institution Licence Application to VFSC Licensing Division
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC - Licensing and Supervision Division (Non-Bank Financial Institutions / Financial Dealers Licensing)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the EMI licence application containing legal entity details, significant ownership, business model, internal AML/CFT controls, payment processing flows, technology and information security framework, and capital evidence. The application must be accompanied by the prescribed licence fee and police clearances for responsible persons.
required_dossiers: Completed EMI licence application form and declaration
Certificate of Incorporation and constitutional documents
AML/CFT compliance manual and screening procedures
Certified evidence of paid-up capital of at least USD 50,000
Business plan and projected payment and e-money flows
Fit-and-proper declarations, police clearances and CVs for directors and senior officers
IT security and system resilience report, including ISO/IEC 27001 controls where available
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues an intention-to-refuse notice, the applicant may make written representations within 30 days; an appeal lies to the VFSC Board and thereafter to the Minister of Finance under the Financial Dealers Act.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission - Licensing and Supervision Division, in coordination with the Department of Finance and Reserve Bank of Vanuatu for payment system access
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Electronic Money Institution (EMI) Licence / Non-Bank Financial Institution Licence for Digital Wallet and Virtual IBAN Issuance under the Financial Dealers Act No. 20 of 2011 and the VFSC Financial Dealers (Licensing) Regulations

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation, Ministry of Climate Change and Natural Disasters, Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 4 - Minimal Environmental Footprint; Registration/Filing Certificate only, no full EIA required for a digital electronic money operation with no manufacturing facility
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: The operation generates no industrial wastewater or process emissions. Any emergency diesel generator must comply with Vanuatu air quality guidelines. Electronic waste from server and office equipment, including batteries, must be classified as controlled e-waste, stored in impervious containers and removed exclusively by a Department-approved waste recycler. Potable water and municipal sewer connections must meet Public Works Department standards.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Rescue Service Certificate of Fire Safety Compliance for the registered office and any server/data room; Ministry of Labour electrical installation safety inspection; building approval confirming structural load capacity for IT equipment racks; occupational health and safety clearance for workstations, emergency lighting and means of egress.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA), under the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, administers the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 245] and customs duties through its Inland Revenue and Customs divisions (portal: www.vrca.gov.vu). The Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) (www.vfsc.vu) is the statutory regulator and corporate registry for International Companies and licensed electronic money institutions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax, no general TIN exists for International Companies. Step 1: Incorporate the International Company (IC) with the VFSC and obtain a unique IC registration number. Step 2: If the IC is statutorily exempt and transacts only with non-residents, no fiscal registration is required and the VFSC number is the sole identifier. Step 3: If the entity also makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or intends to claim 0% VAT on exports, register for VAT with the VRCA and obtain a VAT Identification Number under the BE-1 registration procedure, with monthly or quarterly filing obligations. Step 4: Obtain the VFSC statutory electronic money institution license separately for virtual IBAN issuance and digital wallet reserve management.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: International Companies are non-resident and fully exempt from Vanuatu income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax on dividends, royalties and interest, stamp duty, and exchange control. VAT applies only where the IC makes physical or domestic taxable supplies within Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu does not operate US-style check-the-box classification or hybrid mismatch elections. The International Companies Act provides an irrevocable election upon incorporation for International Company status, which grants complete tax and stamp duty exemption. An IC may forfeit this status by carrying on business with Vanuatu residents or deriving Vanuatu-source domestic revenue, which triggers ordinary local-company VAT obligations. No CFC, thin capitalization, or hybrid instrument rules currently apply.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) on goods and services under the Value Added Tax Act [CAP 245], administered by the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VT 5,000,000 (five million vatu) annual taxable turnover in the preceding 12 months for mandatory VAT registration, equivalent to approximately USD 42,000 at standard exchange rates. An International Company making only offshore supplies has no Vanuatu VAT nexus and no registration requirement.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing system, real-time fiscal clearance API, tax device certification, or digital stamping obligation is currently legislated in Vanuatu. VAT-registered businesses must issue prescribed VAT invoices showing the price, VAT component, BE-1/VAT identification number, and supplier details, and retain records for 7 years. The VRCA may require electronic document upload only during an audit, not as a clearance precondition.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For a Vanuatu International Company operating an electronic money institution (virtual IBAN issuance and digital wallet reserve management), 0% VAT applies to: (i) exported tangible goods that physically leave Vanuatu within 28 days of invoice and are evidenced by customs documentation; and (ii) cross-border financial and payment services supplied to non-residents, where the recipient is outside Vanuatu, the service is wholly consumed offshore, and the consideration is received in convertible foreign currency. Because the IC is statutorily tax-exempt, a practical zero-rating claim arises only if the EMI voluntarily registers for VAT or converts to local company status; otherwise offshore turnover remains outside the Vanuatu VAT net.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document or Form C) approved and stamped by VRCA Customs for goods exports
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing departure from a Vanuatu port or airport and arrival at a foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) or SWIFT MT103 / bank credit advice showing foreign-currency funds received into the Vanuatu bank account
Commercial invoice, packing list, and certificate of origin
For services: executed agreement identifying the non-resident customer and a service attestation that digital wallet and IBAN services are accessed and used wholly outside Vanuatu
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The VRCA blocks refunds for 0% rated exports until the complete customs and remittance documentation bundle is submitted. Unsubstantiated claims give rise to a default VAT assessment with a 25% surcharge and monthly interest of 1.5%. Fraudulent export zero-rating or VAT invoice falsification is criminally punishable by fines up to VT 1,000,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years. Directors of a VFSC-licensed electronic money institution additionally risk license revocation, disqualification, and statutory debarment under the International Companies Act. Retrospective reassessment may claw back up to 8 years of exempted VAT and render the IC taxable as a local company if prohibited domestic business activity is discovered.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), constituted under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125], is the designated monetary authority and exchange-control administrator under the Exchange Control Act [Cap. 20]; the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) separately supervises the Financial Dealers Licensing Act [Cap. 173] under which the proposed electronic-money and virtual-IBAN operation will obtain its principal license. The RBV licenses commercial banks and oversees the domestic clearing and settlement infrastructure.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates a liberal exchange-control regime: the Vatu (VUV) is convertible for both current-account and capital-account transactions without prior exchange-control approval for equity injections, service fees, dividends, or loan repayments, provided the initiating commercial bank acts as an authorized dealer under the Exchange Control Act. Profit remittance from an International Company (VU_IC) is not subject to withholding tax because Vanuatu has no income tax on corporate distributions, and there is no foreign-investment profit-remittance cadence; the residual procedural hurdles are documentary only, namely UBO evidence, source-of-funds verification, and standard foreign-exchange statistical declarations, whereas the material practical hurdle is correspondent-bank de-risking of VUV-denominated fintech flows rather than any domestic legal restriction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Not applicable in Vanuatu. There is no statutory export-proceeds surrender timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio into VUV, and no requirement to repatriate export earnings within a fixed period. An Electronic Money Institution receiving subscription fees, transaction fees, float-holding income, or technology-service revenue offshore may lawfully retain those proceeds in USD, AUD, EUR, or VUV without a forced conversion, subject only to contractual arrangements with its RBV-licensed sponsor bank and to standard exchange-control reporting thresholds.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and VUV operational clearing account with USD/AUD settlement sub-accounts
Capital Escrow Account and VUV operational clearing account with correspondent settlement access
Operational Account and VUV settlement account for sponsor-bank clearing

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium-to-High for a licensed Financial Dealer operating as a virtual-IBAN issuer and digital-wallet operator rather than as a licensed bank. Vanuatu has no dedicated electronic-money institution statute, no EU/EEA passporting regime, and no native SEPA participant status; consequently an offshore EMI established under the International Companies Act can lawfully serve non-resident customers, hold float in USD/AUD, and route settlement via global correspondents, but it must (i) hold a Financial Dealer's Licence from VFSC, (ii) maintain a settlement account with an RBV-licensed bank for any VUV leg, (iii) obtain SEPA reachability through an EEA-licensed partner EMI or bank, and (iv) avoid deposit-taking language and banking activities that would trigger the Banking Act. The commercial model is therefore viable only in a sponsor-bank arrangement for virtual-IBAN issuance and domestic clearing.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In practice, RBV-licensed commercial banks require at least one signatory director and every beneficial owner holding 10% or more to complete an in-person KYC interview with the bank's compliance officer, either at the Port Vila or Luganville branch or via a supervised video session attended by the company's registered agent and a local notary. Vanuatu's AML/CFT rulebook does not statutorily codify a mandatory physical appearance, but the high-risk fintech sector profile makes fully remote account opening effectively unavailable for the first onboarding tranche; the operational baseline is a physical visit by the primary director/UBO to Vanuatu for execution-witnessing and interview, followed by remote maintenance thereafter.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained UBO concealment through International Company nominee layers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Unbroken corporate ownership chart from the registered agent; registered shareholder register evidenced by physical certificates; sworn UBO declaration naming all natural persons at or above 10%; passport and proof-of-residence of each UBO; bank or lawyer professional reference letters from the jurisdiction of origin confirming identity and standing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of wealth for the digital-wallet float and initial capital injection
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Two years of audited financial statements for the EMI and its parent; bank statements on the funding accounts; documented business model and revenue forecast for the virtual-IBAN product; personal income/tax history where the wealthy arose in a taxed jurisdiction; publication-grade bio and traceable incorporation documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Virtual IBAN product flagged as a pass-through or money-mule conduit
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction-monitoring policy compliant with the Financial Action Task Force (FATF) Recommendations, including Travel Rule capture for all originator/beneficiary data; documented daily velocity and counterparty limits; beneficiary-allowlisting control for virtual IBAN issuance; external audit report of the AML system; segregation of customer funds and auditor attestation.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent and sponsor bank unwilling to clear VUV due to insufficient loss-absorption data
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed settlement-account memorandum with an RBV-licensed sponsor bank; audited capital and liquidity attestation showing float reserves held in liquid USD/AUD instruments; parent-company undertaking and surety; legal opinion from Vanuatu counsel confirming the product is a financial-dealer service outside the Banking Act deposit-taking prohibition.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Regulatory scope ambiguity for licensing as an electronic-money business
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Financial Dealer's Licence with defined scope for money transmission and digital finance; filing of approved controllers and senior-management forms; proof of resident registered agent and physical office premises; legal opinion covering non-qualification as deposit-taking; correspondence with VFSC pre-approval attesting to the permitted virtual-IBAN issuance model.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound share capital and subordinated loan proceeds are routed by SWIFT MT103/MT202 to the EMI's settlement account held at an RBV-licensed commercial bank, with beneficiary narration 'VU_IC share capital' or 'VU_IC subordinated loan advance' and the BPM6 purpose classification for equity investment or intercompany lending. No prior RBV exchange-control approval is required, but the receiving authorized dealer will complete a foreign-exchange statistical declaration and may require an anti-money-laundering source-of-funds form if the amount exceeds its domestic reporting threshold; for same-bank VUV transfers, the domestic electronic credit rail is used, and for USD/AUD settlement at the sponsor bank, ISO 20022 camt.054 statements are retained for VFSC and RBV audit.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound disbursements settle through the sponsor bank's corresponding network using SWIFT MT103 (customer credit), MT202 (bank-to-bank liquidity), and MT700-series commercial letters of credit under UCP600 for trade-related settlements. Domestic VUV disbursements clear via the sponsor bank's RBV settlement account through direct-entry, whereas SEPA-cleared trades in EUR must be delegated to an EEA-licensed EMI or bank partner because Vanuatu holds no SEPA participant identifier; USD disbursements are typically netted through correspondent accounts in Australia, New Zealand, Hong Kong, or the United States to avoid expensive VUV cross-border conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts against USD, AUD, and EUR booked with an RBV-authorized dealing bank for tenors up to twelve months
FX swap contracts for short-term liquidity matching between the reserve float and payout obligations
Non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on VUV with non-resident OECD credit counterparties, cash-settled in USD outside Vanuatu
Cross-currency basis swaps matching USD-denominated assets with VUV-denominated settlement liabilities
Currency-netting and prepayment offset arrangements with the sponsor bank to minimize VUV leg exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Annual Government Fee — International Companies Act [Cap 222], ss.126–127
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Registrar of International Companies, Port Vila
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: filing and payment due within 1 month after the anniversary of incorporation; no statutory extension available
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 10% of the unpaid annual fee per commenced month, plus on-conviction fine not exceeding VT 20,000 (≈ USD 167); non-payment for 6 consecutive months triggers Registrar's strike-off warning; continued default permits administrative deregistration with assets vesting in the Government of Vanuatu and directors jointly and severally liable for post-strike-off debts

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Licence Renewal, Compliance Certificate and AML/CFT Annual Submission — Financial Dealers Act [Cap 70] / VASP Act 2021 (Licensed EMI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC, Licensing Division and AML/CFT Supervisory Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal application and annual licence fee due on or before the licensing anniversary (VFSC calendar cycle: 31 January); annual AML/CFT report and audited licence accounts due within 6 months of financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal surcharge of 10% plus daily default fine; licence suspension after 30 days in arrears and revocation on 60 days' notice; carrying on regulated EMI activity without a renewed licence is a criminal offence punishable by fines up to VT 50,000,000 (≈ USD 410,000) and imprisonment of responsible officers

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Financial Statements and Statutory Auditor's Report (prudential supervisory filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC — Banks, Insurance and Financial Services Supervision Division
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months of financial year-end (FYE 31 December → filing by 30 June); auditor's report must be in English and issued by a VFSC-accepted audit firm
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: VFSC administrative penalty up to VT 1,000,000 (≈ USD 8,200) plus VT 25,000 per day of continuing default; suspension or revocation of the EMI licence; personal accountability orders against directors and the MLRO

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Declaration of Compliance and Beneficial Ownership Confirmation — AML/CFT Act 2016, s.19; IC Act [Cap 222], s.108
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC — Registered Agents Compliance Unit (lodged by the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually, together with the IC annual return (within 1 month of the incorporation anniversary); material UBO changes notified within 14 days of the event
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Breach of UBO recording/confirmation duties is an AML/CFT offence with fines up to VT 5,000,000 (≈ USD 41,000) and licence sanctions against the registered agent; the EMI's own licence is at risk of suspension; incomplete registers deprive the company of statutory defences in shareholder disputes

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit for all VFSC-licensed EMIs, payment services and digital-asset entities irrespective of turnover or balance-sheet size (Financial Dealers Act Cap 70 and VASP Act 2021); an unlicensed International Company is audit-exempt under the International Companies Act Cap 222 unless directed by VFSC or required by its shareholders; audit firm must be VFSC-approved and hold recognised professional standing (e.g., ICPA, CPA Australia or UK ICAEW membership)
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted by the VFSC — mandatory for licensed financial/EMI institutions; unlicensed International Companies may apply IFRS for SMEs, UK GAAP or US GAAP at the registered agent's discretion; statutory books are maintained in Vatu, while VFSC reporting may be presented in a USD-functional-currency with Vatu equivalencies

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Anniversary-based annual confirmation: the licensed registered agent must, with each annual return, confirm to VFSC that the beneficial-ownership register is complete and accurate; any share transfer or change of control (10% or more, or any person of significant influence) must be pre-notified to VFSC within 14 days, the UBO register amended, and the transferee verified under AML/CFT due-diligence rules before the transfer is recorded; the UBO register is confidential and not publicly searchable

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,500 – 2,500 per annum for a licensed registered agent with registered office, AML/CFT supervision and corporate secretarial support for a licensed EMI
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000 – 8,000 per annum for a statutory audit of a fintech EMI (digital wallet and virtual IBAN reserve operations) by a VFSC-accepted firm; consolidated group audits attract a higher fee

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% — Vanuatu imposes no general corporate income tax; an International Company (IC) is tax-exempt on offshore income under the International Companies Act [Cap.222] as a Tax_Exempt_Zone structure.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero income tax on worldwide offshore earnings; zero capital gains tax; zero withholding tax; zero stamp duty on offshore share transfers; export supply of regulated EMI services zero-rated for 12.5% VAT; no employer payroll or social tax on expatriate staff.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A — no corporate income tax return exists in Vanuatu. The Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VCIRS) issues no CIT form; the IC's filing obligations are registry and licensing based.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Nil — no periodic CIT filing obligation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Not applicable; no CIT due date arises for the IC or its non-resident shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders are not assessable in Vanuatu; dividend and capital gains flows remain tax-free at both IC and shareholder level.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT penalties apply; penalties instead arise from registry, VFSC license, and VAT non-compliance, described below.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual Return of International Company (s.166, International Companies Act Cap.222) — submitted to the Registrar of International Companies through the VFSC Companies Office online registry (vfsc.vanuatu.vu).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary date of incorporation; a 30-day grace period applies; thereafter penalty accrues until filing or strike-off.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and unique registration number as per the certificate of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter exact registered name; trade names must not be substituted.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Vanuatu physical address of the licensed registered agent maintaining statutory records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign directors must not substitute an overseas address for the agent's address.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full register of directors and shareholders with passport and beneficial ownership details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Beneficial owners must be disclosed to the agent under the AML/CFT Act; nominee structures require a written declaration.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement confirming no business is transacted with Vanuatu residents and no Vanuatu-source income arises.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support the declaration with board minutes and client contracts evidencing foreign sourcing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing fine of VUV 100 per day up to 12 months; subsequent strike-off and dissolution of the IC; restoration requires court order and payment of all outstanding fees; directors of a struck-off IC are jointly liable for debts incurred after dissolution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual License Renewal — Financial Dealer/EMI license renewal filing with audited accounts, solvency certificate, and AML compliance report to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal application and fee must be filed on or before the license expiry date (typically 31 December for VFSC licenses).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Profit and loss extract coding fee income, spread income, and reserve management income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Separately disclose intercompany management fees and reserve custody fees.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statement of liquid net assets supporting outstanding electronic money liabilities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Segregated client reserve accounts must not be shown as company assets.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of FIU compliance, suspicious transaction reports, and beneficial-ownership records.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: An independent annual AML/CFT review may be required; non-resident outsourced compliance officers are unacceptable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Licensed agent's confirmation that the IC remains in good standing.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Certificate must be signed by the Vanuatu resident licensed agent.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Operating without renewal constitutes unlicensed financial dealing — fine up to VUV 100,000 plus VUV 5,000 per day; license suspension and referral to the FIU.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (e-VAT, Value Added Tax Act Cap.262) — filed electronically through the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Bi-monthly (six returns per annum); monthly filing applies where annual turnover exceeds VUV 100 million.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filed and paid within 30 days after the end of each VAT period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Supplies made to Vanuatu residents at 12.5%.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil unless onshore fee revenue (e.g. cash-in/cash-out agent fees) exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: EMI services supplied to non-resident clients, including virtual IBAN issuance and wallet management.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Retain client country evidence: incorporation documents, IP logs, and contract counterparty addresses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT incurred on Vanuatu operating costs (agent fees, office costs; VFSC fees excluded).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-rated exports do not trigger partial exemption; full input credit is recoverable.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output VAT less input VAT; repayment claims arise where input exceeds output.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nil for offshore-only EMI operations; refund claims are audited by VCIRS.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of VAT due per month (max 25%) plus 20% p.a. interest; suppression of export zero-rating: 200% penalty on VAT evaded; criminal prosecution on false returns with fines up to VUV 5,000,000.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — Vanuatu law imposes no dividend withholding tax on distributions from an IC to any shareholder, including foreign beneficial owners.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Not applicable — Vanuatu has no comprehensive double taxation agreement in force. Dividends, royalties, and interest leave Vanuatu gross; reliance is placed on domestic zero-rate status. The OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (effective for Vanuatu on 1 September 2024) affects information exchange, not withholding rights; no TRC or treaty relief form is required or available.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: 0% on royalties and 0% on debt interest paid to non-residents. Treaty rates: no DTA network, therefore no reduction risk. Intra-group debt and IP contracts should still be documented at arm's length to withstand VFSC licensing scrutiny and foreign transfer-pricing audits.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No domestic transfer-pricing statute or documentation threshold exists in VUV. Prudent compliance threshold: prepare Master File and Local File when related-party cross-border transactions (management fees, software licensing, recharges) exceed VUV 30,000,000 per annum, anticipating OECD TP review by counterparty-source jurisdictions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: No standalone Economic Substance Regulation statute is in force; however, commitments under the EU Code of Conduct Group and VFSC prudential licensing conditions require a licensed IC to demonstrate physical presence in Vanuatu, local management, and real income-generating activity when carrying on licensed financial business. Minimum substance markers: physical registered office in Port Vila, licensed agent, resident compliance officer, board records, and accounting records maintained in Vanuatu. An IC lacking these elements is classified as a shell by the FIU, exposing the VFSC license to revocation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlicensed Electronic Money and IBAN Operation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Issuing e-money, virtual IBANs, or processing digital wallet payments without a valid VFSC Financial Dealer/EMI license, or operating beyond the scope of the license granted.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to VUV 100,000 on conviction plus VUV 5,000 for each day the offense continues; confiscation of unlawfully collected fees; mandatory cease-and-desist directions; license refusal if application made ex post.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally subject to fines and imprisonment up to 6 months under the Financial Dealers Act Cap.70; VFSC disqualification orders; civil restitution to injured wallet clients, severally.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: VAT Evasion and False Export Zero-Rating
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Classifying Vanuatu-resident traffic as zero-rated export services to avoid 12.5% VAT, falsifying non-resident client evidence, or failing to register for VAT when onshore taxable turnover exceeds the threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of 200% of the VAT evaded, 20% default interest, and fines on conviction up to VUV 5,000,000; confiscation and disclosure of records to foreign tax authorities under the OECD MAAC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors liable for restitution of evaded VAT; imprisonment up to 7 years under the VAT Act and Criminal Code; travel bans and asset freezes pending criminal trial.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Nominee Director Misconduct
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an IC as a pure shell with no records, no agent oversight, nominee shareholders concealing beneficial owners, or misusing tax-exempt status to facilitate third-party money laundering.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar-initiated strike-off and deregistration; restoration only by court order with all fees paid; AML penalties for beneficial-ownership non-disclosure up to VUV 15,000,000; license revocation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: After strike-off, company debts may be enforced personally against directors; FIU travel bans; money laundering conviction punishable by fine up to VUV 25,000,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Reporting Failure on Digital Wallets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to submit suspicious transaction reports on virtual IBAN/wallet funding flows to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit; deficient customer due diligence, source-of-funds verification, or watchlist screening.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to VUV 25,000,000; corrective directions, independent AML audit, and suspension or revocation of the VFSC license; forfeiture of misused e-money reserves.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individual fines up to VUV 5,000,000; prohibition from holding directorships in any regulated financial institution; custodial sentence; civil liability for client losses resulting from unreported reportable flows.
